description: Cloud AFK auto-reply placeholders (services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'Rule placeholders'). templates: a row's plain text (kind 'reply' with its rule, 'command', or 'console') and the problem a save reports as 400 invalid_command {field, reason, part?} (null: accepted), checked in this order: the text rule, the password commands ('secret'), then the placeholder rules; 'captures' is the rule pattern's capturing group count; 'script' and 'vars' are what afk-host writes for an accepted reply (the script line and the [Match] block's vars=). 'text' or 'value' is null when not well-formed Unicode: 'utf16' then lists its code units in hex. captures: capture counts of patterns pl-afk's check_pattern accepts (Rust regex numbering: every capturing group by its opening parenthesis, named or not). values: the strict class of MCC_MATCH_VARS=strict. runs: one rule, one chat line as MCC reads it (type public / private / other, sender, message), what the bot sends (null, with why: from, self, nomatch, value); their patterns read alike in JavaScript, .NET and Rust. Generated by generate-rule-placeholder-v1.mjs; do not edit by hand.
